title: Underwater search is on for Bukidnon man swept off bamboo raft

blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Local scuba divers and search teams from the Valencia City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) are conducting an underwater search-and-retrieval operation at the San Carlos National Irrigation Dam to locate a 38-year-old man who went missing on Sunday morning, October 18. The victim was identified as Rocky Bitos, a resident of Barangay Colonia, Valencia City. Rudy Guadalupe, Barangay Colonia village chief, told the Inquirer Tuesday morning that Bitos was riding a handmade bamboo raft (gakit) downstream with his 15-year-old son and three neighbors—all men in their 40s—when strong, turbulent river currents overwhelmed their raft.
